item.title: St Magnus Cathedral Organ Set for Major Refurbishment After 50 Years
item.description: A major £500,000 refurbishment is planned for the historic organ at St Magnus Cathedral in Kirkwall, aiming to secure the future of a 1925 instrument that plays a central role in worship, culture and community life at Scotland’s most complete medieval cathedral. The post St Magnus Cathedral Organ Set for Major Refurbishment After 50 Years appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Imported Eggs Questioned After Salmonella Cases Spark Safety Warning
item.description: NFU Scotland has issued fresh consumer guidance after Salmonella cases were linked to imported eggs, warning that UK and Scottish eggs remain among the safest in the world and calling for stronger standards, clearer labelling and equal rules for imported food.The post Imported Eggs Questioned After Salmonella Cases Spark Safety Warning appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Plans Lodged to Bring Grant Lodge Back to Life in Elgin
item.description: Plans have been submitted to regenerate Grant Lodge in Elgin as part of the Moray Growth Deal, with proposals aiming to restore the historic building as a cultural, tourism and events hub that reconnects a cherished landmark with community life and long term economic growth.The post Plans Lodged to Bring Grant Lodge Back to Life in Elgin appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Thousands Targeted by Self Assessment Scams as Tax Deadline Approaches
item.description: Thousands of Self Assessment scams have been reported to HMRC as the tax deadline approaches, with officials warning people to stay alert to fake emails, texts and calls designed to steal personal information during the busiest time of year for tax returns.The post Thousands Targeted by Self Assessment Scams as Tax Deadline Approaches appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Scottish Parties Respond as UK Moves to Rejoin Erasmus From 2027
item.description: Scotland’s Constitution Secretary and opposition parties have welcomed plans for the UK to rejoin Erasmus from 2027, while warning that trust must be rebuilt after Brexit and calling for wider steps to remove barriers with Europe and support young people and learners.The post Scottish Parties Respond as UK Moves to Rejoin Erasmus From 2027 appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Grant Presses for Urgent Talks on Domestic Abuse Services Funding
item.description: Uncertainty over funding for domestic abuse services in the Highlands has prompted Labour MSP Rhoda Grant to seek urgent talks with Highland Council, warning that Women’s Aid groups face difficult decisions at a time when demand for support is rising.The post Grant Presses for Urgent Talks on Domestic Abuse Services Funding appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Highland Built Motorads Sets Sights on Shaking Up The UK Car Market
item.description: A new Highland built tech platform is preparing to challenge the UK’s biggest car advertising sites, with Motorads using AI driven search and fairer pricing to modernise vehicle sales while creating skilled jobs rooted in the Highlands.The post Highland Built Motorads Sets Sights on Shaking Up The UK Car Market appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Shetland Lib Dems Urge Scottish Government to Back Inter Island Tunnels With Bonds
item.description: Shetland Liberal Democrats are urging the Scottish Government to use its planned infrastructure bonds to back inter island tunnels, arguing the projects could transform connectivity, reverse depopulation, and deliver long term benefits for island communities if ministers act now.The post Shetland Lib Dems Urge Scottish Government to Back Inter Island Tunnels With Bonds appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: £3.5m Drugs Seizure in Fraserburgh Sparks North East Concern
item.description: A £3.5m drugs seizure in Fraserburgh has led to five arrests and raised concerns about organised supply routes across the North East, Moray and the Highlands, as police warn the recovery highlights the scale of criminal networks operating across regional boundaries.The post £3.5m Drugs Seizure in Fraserburgh Sparks North East Concern appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Scottish Government Sets Out Next Steps to Tackle Child Sexual Abuse
item.description: The Scottish Government has set out urgent next steps to tackle child sexual abuse, including immediate action from a national review, new funding for victim support, and work towards mandatory reporting, with ministers pledging that survivors’ voices will be central to future decisions.The post Scottish Government Sets Out Next Steps to Tackle Child Sexual Abuse appeared first on The Highland Times.
